strengths: Mature tool use and JSON mode
weaknesses: Older generation; superseded by GPT-5 family for new work
prompting_quirks: Image inputs work well with explicit instructions about what to look for
JSON mode is reliable but stricter than schema-based outputs in GPT-5
best_for: Existing pipelines built around 4o where migration cost is high
avoid_for: New projects — GPT-5 mini is usually a better starting point
notes: Still useful for vision and existing pipelines.
pricing_notes: Standard rate. Image inputs are billed separately based on tile count. Audio (4o-audio variants) is priced differently.
